name: Ranchou
source:
Hero is the editor of a talented young girl writer. The year of his publishing company exclusive rights over this author is coming to an end without any book written, so hero isolates the girl in a small hotel populated by other girls to produce a creative atmosphere.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-december-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
英雄是一位才华横溢的年轻女作家的编辑。他的出版公司对这位作者的独家版权一年即将结束，他还没有写出一本书，所以英雄将这个女孩隔离在一个小旅馆里，周围都是其他女孩，以营造一种创作氛围。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-december-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
